case.narrative: I got 5 lights on my dash stating that I have an auto high beam problem, road departure mitigation system problem, collision mitigation system problem, lane keeping assist problem, and adaptive cruise control problem. I got these lights on my dash at the exact same time and this happened 1 week after my car alarm started going off randomly. I will now have to change my windshield camera sensor. Seems like this is an issue with many Acura owners.

The extraction labels the condition as intermittent, and the rulebook's intermittent entry calls for a long-run power cycling test to reproduce faults that appear after repeated wake and sleep cycles.
